Package dev.relism.flash.ext.data.core

Class Tx

java.lang.Object
dev.relism.flash.ext.data.core.Tx
public final class Tx extends Object
Runs work in a transaction of one TxManager: commits when it returns, rolls back when it throws or was marked rollback-only. Its nesting is its own, per thread: two Tx over two databases never see each other's transaction.

A RuntimeException leaves exactly as it was thrown — an HttpException keeps its status — and a checked exception is wrapped in TxException.

    • read

      public <T> T read(Tx.TxCallable<T> work)
      Reads inside the caller's transaction when there is one, and in none otherwise: the reads nested in work share one connection, without a BEGIN and a COMMIT around them. Use call(readOnly(), work) when the reads must see one snapshot.
